headline: Linn Mercy Passes Wholly to Colonials as Callahan's Line Yields a Post
war_summary: The lines have shifted again since the evening edition. Linn Mercy, ten Colonial and one Warden at the last filing, now stands wholly Colonial across eleven squares, with events still being logged at Lathair this morning. Callahan's Passage is no longer wholly Warden: nine of its ten posts remain under Warden colors, but Colonials have recovered a foothold there, and the sector's twenty-four-hour ledger of twenty-five events, fourteen of them at The Latch, is the busiest on the map. Stonecradle, which held one ruined post, now reads seven Colonial to two Warden. Elsewhere the lines hold: Mooring County wholly Warden at twelve, Viper Pit Warden at eight, Nevish Line seven Warden to one Colonial, Stlican Shelf six Colonial to three Warden, the Weathered Expanse seven Colonial to two Warden, and Fisherman's Row nine Colonial to none. The heaviest casualty rolls of the past day fall in the Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle, Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf, Linn Mercy and Mooring County, where fighting continues. The war stands at day 448 with no victor declared.
